purpose: Replace only a failed checkpoint's whole-page attempt with a separately reviewed strip assembly; retain successful checkpoint readings and all failed originals.
prompt:
Transcribe the large Greek authorial text of this scanned page exactly,
preserving its polytonic accents, breathings, punctuation, headings, and codex
numbers. Read a full-width paragraph before moving to two-column text; read
two-column text down the left column and then down the right column. Omit the
running page header, page number, marginal reference numbers, printer signatures,
and the smaller critical apparatus at the foot of the page. Keep the Greek
prefatory letter when present. Do not complete broken words, modernize spelling,
correct the printed text, translate, or add explanations. Output only the
transcription, with paragraph and column boundaries as blank lines.

review.evidence: Printed page243 finishes codex225 and opens codex226 on Eulogius in the left column. Six source-checked enlarged strips retain both complete Greek body columns and the226 heading. Enlarged interline checks preserve accents, breathings, and descenders at each internal split. The lower boundary at.849 lies below the authorial body and above the small apparatus; the top excludes the running header. No long dotted lacuna occurs in the body.
review.failure: The original Qwen3.8 reaches its output limit while repeating text. Preserve it as evidence and retain the independent Qwen3.6 whole-page reading.
review.admission_policy: Only the listed checkpoint receives an assembled replacement vote after a completed output-to-scan review. Keep every original and retry prediction; no extra votes or arbitrary choice.
